name: BottomNByGroupNode
label: Bottom N By Group
description: Filters the data table to keep only the bottom N rows (by an ordering column) within each group.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: GroupByColumns
fields.label: Group By Columns
fields.description: Comma-separated columns that define the groups.

fields.name: OrderByColumn
fields.label: Order By Column
fields.description: The column used to determine which rows are the bottom N.

fields.name: Ascending
fields.label: Ascending
fields.description: True to keep the smallest N values, false for the largest N. Defaults to true (smallest).

fields.name: N
fields.label: N
fields.description: The number of bottom rows to keep per group. Defaults to 1.
